component.name: stable-diffusion.cpp (CPU)
component.summary: Generate images and video locally on the CPU

description.p: Run diffusion models locally with the embedded browser interface, HTTP APIs, or command-line tools. This CPU edition is a community package of the official upstream Linux build, repackaged unmodified.
The desktop entry starts the server in a terminal. Open http://127.0.0.1:1234/ in your browser and keep the terminal open. Model weights are downloaded separately and follow their own licenses.

Place model files in category folders such as checkpoints, diffusion_models, text_encoders and vae under ~/.var/app/io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU/data/models/. Relative CLI output is saved under ~/.var/app/io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU/data/. Access to additional model directories is optional:

ul.li: Read models from Downloads: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-download:ro io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU
Write output to Pictures: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-pictures io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU
Undo these grants: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU

description.p: Use sd-cli through flatpak run --command=sd-cli io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU, or pass server options through flatpak run io.github.leejet.StableDiffusionCpp.CPU. CPU and Vulkan editions have separate model directories and browser origins.
